summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Calamos Bitcoin Structured Alt Protection ETF - October (CBOO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is actively managed to provide limited upside potential, while fully hedging downside risk relative to bitcoin over a one-year period, starting each October. The funds objective attempts to remove the volatility of a volatile asset class that is uncorrelated to traditional securities. CBOO was launched on Oct 7, 2025 and is issued by Calamos.
